item.title: [Backport release-26.05] flameshot: toctou symlink attack fix (CVE-2026-62294)
item.description:
In versions of Flameshot prior to 14.0, CVE-2026-62294 is present (TOCTOU symlink attack via "Open With..."). On the 26.05 release branch, Flameshot is on version 13.3.0, thus exposed to the vulnerability. This PR pulls patches in commit with the security fix while preserving current package version.

Resolves #544166
